name: Trigger.dev developer platform landing page by trigger.dev
description: A long-form dark landing page built on a near-black canvas with a single disciplined lime-green accent for primary actions, plus rotating per-feature hues (green, pink, blue, purple) on eyebrows, icons and status pills. Credibility comes from real artefacts everywhere: syntax-highlighted code editors, live-looking product UI mockups (task queues, filters, charts), node-flow diagrams and a video walkthrough instead of stock illustration. Rhythm shifts deliberately down the page — airy centred hero, dense two-column code demo, alternating feature rows, a three-column mega-list at peak density, then a masonry testimonial wall, stat row and a compact CTA before the link-column footer.
